start: Any admin-app page, signed in as owner to a real gym (not the demo); HQ sent a message in the last 14 days; this browser never opened the bell

steps.action: Look at the bell
user_sees: A number on the bell that counts the HQ message ('Notifications, <n> new' or '<n> waiting for you')
must_not: No number in a browser that never opened the bell
A number in the demo gym

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: Panel 'Notifications'
Group 'From MettleUp' with its count
The message: India date, a 'New' tag, title, body with its line breaks; its button '<label> ›'
must_not: HQ's text run as code or as a link it did not ask for
An empty 'From MettleUp' heading with nothing under it

steps.action: Tap the message's button
user_sees: The panel closes and the admin-app page opens; an https address opens in a new tab
must_not: A refused or blank page
The gym's sign-in passed to an outside address

steps.action: Open the bell again
user_sees: The same message without the 'New' tag; the bell's number no longer counts it
must_not: The message counted as new again on this browser

start: Admin app open all day as owner; HQ sends a new message meanwhile

steps.action: Wait up to 15 minutes with the tab in view, or come back to the tab, or tap Refresh in the top bar
user_sees: The bell's number goes up by one
must_not: The page jumping or redrawing when nothing changed
A wait until the next sign-in

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: The new message first under 'From MettleUp', with 'New'
must_not: Older messages marked 'New' again

start: Signed in as owner; the HQ message list cannot be read, or a message is not well formed

steps.action: Open the bell while the internet is off
user_sees: The bell without a 'From MettleUp' group; no error
must_not: A red error for a list that is only news
A stuck spinner

steps.action: HQ sends a message whose link is neither an admin-app page nor an https address
user_sees: The message with no button
must_not: A button that opens an http or script address

steps.action: Open the demo gym
user_sees: No HQ messages
must_not: Real HQ messages shown inside the demo

start: An HQ message already seen in this browser as owner

steps.action: Open the admin app in a second browser that never opened the bell
user_sees: The message counts as new there (seen is kept per browser)
must_not: A message older than 14 days counted as new on a first look

steps.action: Clear this browser's site data and sign in again
user_sees: Messages of the last 14 days count as new once more
must_not: Every old message since the start counted

steps.action: HQ takes the message back
user_sees: It is gone from the bell at the next read
must_not: A count on the bell for a message that is no longer listed

start: HQ writes one message for every gym; owner reads it

steps.action: Open the bell
user_sees: The same words every gym gets
must_not: Words about one gym, a person or a payment in a message all gyms read
Another gym's alerts under 'Your gym'

steps.action: Read the list without signing in (it is public by design)
user_sees: Only title, body, date, link and label
must_not: Who at HQ wrote it
Which gyms opened it sent back to HQ
